description: Upload an end thumbnail — an image shown after the video finishes. Provide `image_url` pointing to a publicly reachable JPG, PNG or GIF up to 5 MB. The upload also creates the end CTA, so the image shows in the player right away. A video has one end thumbnail: a new upload replaces the previous one. Returns {response: {endThumbnail: <name>}}.

image_url.description: Public URL of the image to upload

name: panda_add_end_thumbnail
title: Add End Thumbnail
